title: script.painless.regex.enabled: true still applies regex.limit-factor
body:
### Elasticsearch Version

7.10.0+

### Installed Plugins

_No response_

### Java Version

Not relevant

### OS Version

Not relevant

### Problem Description

`script.painless.regex.enabled`: `true` should ignore the `limit-factor` but it is being applied.

Tracing the code, the static constants are being set correctly, in `Compiler.compile`.  `CompilerSettings.asMap()` is also returning `0` for the `regex_limit_factor` if `enabled` is `true`.


### Steps to Reproduce
```
PUT test/_doc/1
{
  "abc": "abcdef.abcdef.abcdef.1122.xxddee.%%%%.___"
}

POST test/_search
{
  "size": 10,
  "query": {
    "script": {
      "script": {
        "source": "doc['abc.keyword'].value =~ /.*abc.*def.*hij.*/",
        "lang": "painless",
        "params": {
          "abc": "def"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```
```
   "error": {
        "root_cause": [
            {
                "type": "circuit_breaking_exception",
                "reason": "[scripting] Regular expression considered too many characters, pattern: [.*abc.*def.*hij.*], limit factor: [85], char limit: [3485], count: [3486], wrapped: [abcdef.abcdef.abcdef.1122.xxddee.%%%%.___], this limit can be changed by changed by the [script.painless.regex.limit-factor] setting",
                "bytes_wanted": 0,
                "bytes_limit": 0,
                "durability": "TRANSIENT"
            }
        ],
```


### Logs (if relevant)


Looking at the code, I see 85 being loaded as a constant directly.

```
  // access flags 0x1
  public execute()Z
    LDC 1000000
    ISTORE 1
   L0
   L1
    LINENUMBER 1 L1
    ALOAD 0
    INVOKEVIRTUAL org/elasticsearch/painless/PainlessScript$Script.getDoc ()Ljava/util/Map;
    ASTORE 2
    GETSTATIC org/elasticsearch/painless/PainlessScript$Script.constant$synthetic$0 : Ljava/util/regex/Pattern;
    ASTORE 3
   L2
    LINENUMBER 43 L2
    ALOAD 3
    BIPUSH 85
    ALOAD 2
    LDC "abc.keyword"
   L3
    LINENUMBER 47 L3
   L4
    LINENUMBER 46 L4
    INVOKEINTERFACE java/util/Map.get (Ljava/lang/Object;)Ljava/lang/Object; (itf)
   L5
    LINENUMBER 61 L5
    INVOKEDYNAMIC value(Ljava/lang/Object;)Ljava/lang/Object; [
      // handle kind 0x6 : INVOKESTATIC
      org/elasticsearch/painless/PainlessScript$Script.$bootstrapDef(Ljava/lang/invoke/MethodHandles$Lookup;Ljava/lang/String;Ljava/lang/invoke/MethodType;II[Ljava/lang/Object;)Ljava/lang/invoke/CallSite;
      // arguments:
      0, 
      1
    ]
   L6
    LINENUMBER 61 L6
    INVOKESTATIC org/elasticsearch/painless/Def.defToStringImplicit (Ljava/lang/Object;)Ljava/lang/String;
    INVOKESTATIC org/elasticsearch/painless/api/Augmentation.matcher (Ljava/util/regex/Pattern;ILjava/lang/CharSequence;)Ljava/util/regex/Matcher;
    INVOKEVIRTUAL java/util/regex/Matcher.find ()Z
    IRETURN
   L7
```
